The vehicle approaches a marked crosswalk in lane while a pedestrian is on it or steps onto it

One concrete scenario (seeded sample of the logical
scenario)
ODD-20 Ego speed: 47.9 km/h (range 0 to 48 km/h)
ODD-03 Posted speed limit: 30 mph (the stated bound)
ODD-05 Crossings: marked-crosswalk
ODD-16 Traffic participants: pedestrian
ODD-12 Illumination: night
ODD-10 Precipitation: 0.6 mm/h (range 0 to 2.5 mm/h)
ODD-13 Road surface condition: wet

Pedestrian walking speed and start time: Bound stated by
FSR-06.01, not yet fixed; the motion drawn is choreography

Ego slows at 3 m/s², the firm level of FSR-03.02 (DQ-019, DQ-033);
choreography, not Autoware's planned braking
Safety goals at stake

SG-02 (ASIL D): Decelerate at least as much as needed to avoid a
collision the planned trajectory avoids
SG-03 (ASIL C): Avoid unintended hard deceleration

SG-06 (ASIL D): Do not enter an intersection, roundabout or
crosswalk against right of way
Pass criterion

No contact with the pedestrian; the vehicle yields as the traffic
rules require, and the monitor commands the deceleration that
restores the safe distance whenever Autoware does not; unjustified
hard braking counts against the SOTIF acceptance criteria
(FSR-02.01, FSR-02.02, FSR-02.05, FSR-03.01, FSR-06.01, FSR-06.03,
AC-02)

Meant to do: yields before the crosswalk

Where the hazard lies: HE-02.1 Does not slow down for a pedestrian on the crosswalk; HE-06.4 Does not yield to a pedestrian on the crosswalk
